result.summary: The homepage is mostly coherent, but a restaurant card image is stuck in a loading spinner state and the pizza promo card is cropped so its restaurant name and details never appear.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image is covered by a persistent circular loading spinner, so the dish photo never fully appears.
issues.suggestion: Finish loading the image or hide the spinner after a timeout/error so the card image is visible.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom is cut off mid-image, so the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details that other cards show never appear.
issues.suggestion: Give the card enough height or padding so the title and metadata sit fully on-screen above the tab bar.
